text: @stardustlc/dsh-suite 是面向 DSH 桌面与 Web profile 的插件组合包，通过声明式补丁一次装入日历、邮件、媒体、开发工具和消息集成等 18 个独立组件，并附带极简 PTC agent 预设。套件还为组件详情页和工作台接入更新区域，集中展示版本、更新说明与更新偏好；用户可检查并确认安装，自动安装默认关闭。适合希望在一个 profile 中管理多种 DSH 插件的用户。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 或更新版本；各组件的账号和本机运行环境要求仍分别适用。

@stardustlc/dsh-suite bundles 18 DSH plugins and a minimal PTC preset. It adds update panels to plugin details and workbenches for reviewing versions and choosing installs; automatic installation is off. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 or newer; component accounts and runtimes remain separate.
想一次给 DSH 装上一组常用插件。
有没有办法在插件详情页查看并管理更新？
我想把邮件、日历和媒体工具放进同一个 DSH profile。
让 DSH 提供一个简洁的 PTC agent 预设。
我希望检查插件版本后再决定是否安装更新。
需要一套包含 Slack 和钉钉集成的 DSH 插件配置。
I want to install a bundle of useful plugins into one DSH profile.
Can I review plugin versions and choose when to install updates?
@stardustlc/dsh-suite 的功能「组合安装」：通过 DSH bundle 补丁加载 18 个独立插件组件。用户在 profile 启用套件即可统一组合这些组件。
@stardustlc/dsh-suite 的功能「极简 PTC 预设」：提供带简洁 persona 的 agent 配置，并组合 shell、文件系统等工具行。由 preset-ptc-minimal 补丁装入。
@stardustlc/dsh-suite 的功能「插件更新检查」：更新区域可查询所选组件的版本信息并显示更新状态。用户在插件详情页或工作台底部查看。
@stardustlc/dsh-suite 的功能「确认后安装更新」：更新界面在用户确认后请求安装指定插件版本，并可在需要时取消操作。
@stardustlc/dsh-suite 的功能「更新偏好」：用户可保存按插件区分的检查与自动安装偏好；启用自动安装需显式确认。

@stardustlc/dsh-suite README · 安装：桌面版可在「插件」面板按包名 `@stardustlc/dsh-suite` 安装。已配置 dsh 命令时也可使用：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @stardustlc/dsh-suite
```

网页版把命令中的 `desktop` 改为 `web`。安装后重启 DSH。

@stardustlc/dsh-suite README · 开始使用：1. 把 @stardustlc/dsh-suite 安装到实际使用的 desktop 或 web profile，完成后重启该 profile。
2. 在插件管理中检查 Suite 与组件加载情况；本包包含 18 个组件，Review 与 Computer Use 另外安装。
3. 只配置要使用的组件：邮件和日历需要自己的账号，媒体工具需要对应本机环境。
4. 从左侧栏工作台或对话工具开始一个具体任务，按各组件说明核对实际结果。
5. 在组件页面底部检查更新；Suite 安装的组件通过整包更新，是否安装及何时重启由你决定。

@stardustlc/dsh-suite README · 依赖与配置：profile 只启用 Suite 这一层，由它加载组件。组件的账号、外部程序与网络要求仍各自适用。

本版同步全部 18 个组件的独立更新入口。九个原生工作台保留中英文、深浅色、窄屏和未保存保护；其余组件在自己的设置项中提供更新操作。独立插件仍可分别安装。

同时包含 PPT 0.20.0，在演示文稿工作台按需要下载「分享成品包」或「完整工程包」。分享包附当前讲稿，工程包保留 JSON；下载无需 AI 预审。功能版本升级由用户确认，自动安装默认关闭。

需要官方 DSH **0.2.1-rc.3 或更新版本**；本轮在 **0.2.1-rc.4** 复查。设计与维护见[工作台说明](docs/WORKBENCH_UI.md)，实际操作边界见[本轮验收](docs/validation-2026-10-28-boundaries.md)。Review 与 Computer Use 继续作为独立插件提供，不计入本包的 18 个组件。

@stardustlc/dsh-suite README · 兼容性与混合安装：- 需要官方 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 或更新版本。宿主更旧时组件仍会加载，但页面底部的更新入口不会出现——先升级 DSH，再回到插件详情页查看。
- Suite 锁定组件版本，整包一起更新：在任一组件页面底部操作的都是 Suite 整包。
- 组件也可以独立安装并单独更新。但不要同时用两种方式安装同一个组件：profile 会出现重复的 loader 条目（`duplicate loader entry id`），处理见[迁移步骤](docs/USAGE.md#从旧版全家桶迁移)。
- 新版本与当前环境不匹配时（例如要求更新的 DSH 或 Node.js），页面底部会写明原因，并保留当前版本继续使用；升级环境后再检查即可。

详细配置、工具参数与排错见[使用说明](docs/USAGE.md)。从源码独立开发时，Node 要求以 [package.json](package.json) 为准。

@stardustlc/dsh-suite README · 插件更新：需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 或更新版本。更新控件直接位于原有工作台内容末尾；没有工作台的插件，位于原生插件详情页底部。检查、更新记录和偏好在原地展开，不增加独立更新页面或设置菜单。自动检查默认开启；**自动安装默认关闭**，明确授权后才会在空闲且没有未保存修改时安装兼容的稳定补丁。开关按插件独立保存，可关闭、推迟或忽略提醒；不会强制重启 DSH、升级 DSH 本体或替换本地源码安装。Suite 组件在当前页面底部明确说明并操作 Suite 整包更新。

旧版用户需要先在官方插件管理中手动更新 Suite 一次，之后才会获得这些入口。

@stardustlc/dsh-suite README · What is included：Nine components ship a native main-area workbench (Calendar, Citations, Code Security, Dream, Email, HyperFrames, PPT, Remotion, RSS); the rest are used from their own settings sections or conversation tools. Capabilities, tool arguments and self-checks are listed in the [usage guide](docs/USAGE.en.md#whats-inside-18).

@stardustlc/dsh-suite README · What is included：[@stardustlc/dsh-review](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review) (Git change review) and [deepseek-computer-use](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/deepseek-computer-use) (Windows desktop control) are companion plugins and are **not** part of these 18 components.

@stardustlc/dsh-suite README · Install：In DSH Desktop, install `@stardustlc/dsh-suite` from the Plugins panel. If the bundled dsh command is available:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @stardustlc/dsh-suite
```

For the web version, replace `desktop` with `web`. Restart DSH after installation.

@stardustlc/dsh-suite README · Start using it：1. Install @stardustlc/dsh-suite in the desktop or web profile you use, then restart that profile.
2. Check Suite and its components in plugin management. The bundle contains 18 components; install Review and Computer Use separately.
3. Configure only the components you need: email/calendar require your accounts, and media tools require their local runtimes.
4. Start a concrete task from a sidebar workbench or conversation tools and verify its real result.
5. Check updates at the bottom of a component page. Suite components update as a bundle; you choose installation and restart timing.

@stardustlc/dsh-suite README · Requirements and configuration：Enable only the suite bundle in the profile; it loads the components. Each component still has its own account, executable and network requirements.

This version synchronizes independent update controls across all 18 components. Nine native workbenches retain host language, theme, narrow-window support and edit protection; the remaining components provide controls in their own settings sections. Components remain independently installable.

@stardustlc/dsh-suite README · Requirements and configuration：Requires official DSH **0.2.1-rc.3 or newer**; this round was checked on **0.2.1-rc.4**. See the [workbench guide](docs/WORKBENCH_UI.md) and [validation record](docs/validation-2026-10-28-boundaries.md) for actual-operation boundaries. Review and Computer Use remain separate plugins outside this bundle's 18 components.

@stardustlc/dsh-suite README · Compatibility and mixed installs：- Requires official DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 or newer. On an older host the components still load, but the update control at the bottom of the page is absent: upgrade DSH first, then reopen the plugin details.
- Suite pins component versions and updates them as one bundle; the footer on any component page acts on the whole Suite.
- Components can also be installed and updated independently. Do not install the same component both ways: the profile ends up with a duplicate loader entry (`duplicate loader entry id`); see the [migration steps](docs/USAGE.en.md#migrate-an-older-suite-installation).
- When a new release does not match this environment (a newer DSH or Node.js is required, for example), the footer states the reason and the current version keeps working; check again after upgrading.

@stardustlc/dsh-suite README · Compatibility and mixed installs：Detailed configuration, tool arguments and troubleshooting are in the [usage guide](docs/USAGE.en.md). For standalone development, follow the Node requirement in [package.json](package.json).

@stardustlc/dsh-suite README · Plugin updates：Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 or newer. Update controls sit at the bottom of the existing workbench, or native plugin details for plugins without a workbench. Checks, release notes and preferences expand in place, with no separate update page or settings menu. Automatic checks are on by default; **automatic installation is off by default**. Only explicit opt-in permits compatible stable patches while idle with no unsaved changes. Preferences are independent, with per-plugin disable, deferral and ignore controls. No forced DSH restart or upgrade, and local-source installations stay unchanged. Suite components explain and operate on the whole Suite in the same footer.
@stardustlc/dsh-suite README · Plugin updates：Older Suite releases need one manual update in native plugin management to acquire these controls.
